notes: New bean by photo: fields printed on the bag (Region, Producer, Proceso, Variedad …) are read first, in several languages; «natural roast» or honey as a taste note no longer set the process; product name, producer, roaster from the company line or web address; rest time from the bag; tap a word to use it as process, altitude or producer; «Copy the read text». The brew file now starts at the top after rating, with a band over the clock. The Brew tab tiles no longer flash at start.
